selachian-ursine-stalker.summary: A chunky chimera with a heavy grey-furred quadruped torso, a smooth ivory shark hood and dorsal fin, and a sweeping tail blade.
selachian-ursine-stalker.pose: A stalking quadruped stance with arched furred back, white shark head angled three-quarters down to the left, and long caudal fin sweeping across the lower flank.

graphite-shard-slab.summary: An angular, sharp-edged wedge simulating a scored pencil flake of slate.

bristle-clump.summary: A spiky cluster of faceted conical quills imitating rough directional pencil hatching.

cranial-fin-marker.summary: A smooth curved fin blade of white compressed stone rising like a shark crest from the fractured ground.

things.text: A bristle quill, scoured off the graphite moraine.
